name: Fordwich Arms
lunchNote: Set menu, 3 courses · Tue–Thu, also Fri lunch (tasting menu £110)
dinnerNote: Tasting menu (3-course à la carte £85, set menu £45 Tue–Thu)

menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; optional lobster course £40 (£12 more with the pairing)

menus.name: Three-course à la carte
menus.note: Lunch or dinner, for tables of up to five (a shorter à la carte for 6 to 9)

menus.name: Set menu
menus.note: Tuesday to Thursday lunch and dinner, and Friday lunch; not in December; a matched glass with each course at £8

bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable on the pub's website, or by phone or email.
cancellation: At least 48 hours' notice is asked for. Bookings cancelled within 48 hours, or missed without notice, are charged £40 per person.
groups: The tasting menu is served to any group size; the à la carte is for tables of five or fewer, with a shorter à la carte for 6 to 9 guests. Private dining, events and celebrations by direct enquiry to reservations@fordwicharms.co.uk.
